title: Herding with Multiple States: When the Prior Matters
abstract: arXiv:2611.13632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In sequential observational learning with more than two states, the same information structure and preferences can yield learning for some full-support priors and herding for others. This disproves a conjecture of Kartik, Lee, Liu, and Rappoport (2024, working-paper version). In the counterexample, the cascade region has nonempty interior, yet learning occurs for generic full-support priors outside it. Focusing on information and preferences, we introduce two necessary conditions for learning. Escapability requires that signals can provide arbitrarily strong evidence that any given action is ex post suboptimal; pairwise escapability is its pairwise variant. If escapability fails, herding occurs for some initial prior; if pairwise escapability fails, it occurs for every full-support prior. translated_title: 多状态下的羊群效应：先验何时重要
translated_abstract: 在状态多于两个的序贯观察学习中，相同的信息结构和偏好可能对某些全支撑先验产生学习，而对另一些先验产生羊群效应。这一结果推翻了Kartik、Lee、Liu和Rappoport（2024年工作论文版本）的一个猜想。在该反例中，级联区域具有非空内部，然而对于该区域之外的一般性全支撑先验，学习仍然会发生。聚焦于信息与偏好，我们提出了学习的两个必要条件：可逃逸性要求信号能够提供任意强的证据，表明任何给定行动在事后是次优的；成对可逃逸性是其成对情形的变体。若可逃逸性不成立，则对某些初始先验会出现羊群效应；若成对可逃逸性不成立，则对每一个全支撑先验都会出现羊群效应。对于具有区间最优性和单调似然比的一类环境，可逃逸性完全刻画了学习与羊群效应的发生，且独立于先验。
tldr: 本文在多状态序贯观察学习中证明相同的信息结构与偏好可因先验不同而导致学习或羊群效应，推翻了Kartik等人（2024）的猜想，并提出“可逃逸性”与“成对可逃逸性”作为刻画学习与羊群效应的必要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in multi-state sequential observational learning, the same information structure and preferences can yield learning under some full-support priors but herding under others, disproving a conjecture of Kartik et al. (2024), and introduces "escapability" and "pairwise escapability" as necessary conditions characterizing learning and herding.
